title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
summary: Find the longest contiguous stretch of the string in which each character appears at most once.

contractDetails.constraints: The length is 0–100,000. The source permits English letters, digits, symbols and spaces without enumerating the symbol set. Review the platform character policy before deployment.

statement: Find the longest contiguous stretch of the string in which each character appears at most once. Return its length. Spaces and punctuation participate, and uppercase and lowercase are distinct.

examples.explanation: The stretch xyb! has four distinct characters.
A space counts as a character, but both q's cannot fit.
The empty string has no nonempty stretch.

constraints: The length is 0–100,000. The source permits English letters, digits, symbols and spaces without enumerating the symbol set. Review the platform character policy before deployment.
hints: Conceptual: A repeated character makes the current stretch too long on its left side.
Directional: Remember the most recent position of each character.
Implementation: Move the window start past a repeat only if its previous position is still in the window. Record the widest window reached.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) expected time and O(min(n, A)) auxiliary space, where A is the alphabet size. One last-position lookup is needed per character.
